intro: Small in size, big on function, our Jaxon Compact table blends elegance with smart storage and a lift-up top. It is perfect for work, snacks, or winding down.

features.title: Warm, suede finish
features.text: Elegant in a Rimini Walnut suede finish, your table adds a grounded, modern charm to any compact living space.

features.title: Lift-up versatility
features.text: The tabletop lifts to transform into a working or snacking surface—ideal for busy mornings or lazy evenings.

features.title: Storage, built right in
features.text: Keep your essentials organized with hidden compartments—everything you need, right where you need it.

features.title: Access from both sides
features.text: Dual-side access makes it easy to grab your remote, books, or chargers—no stretching or scrambling.

features.title: Light, lifted look
features.text: An elevated structure creates visual space and makes cleaning underneath a breeze - making it a perfect addition to your cspace.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Jaxon Compact Lift Top Coffee Table With Hidden Storage
